evidence.headline: In single-task and jointly trained four-task LeWorldModel (LeWM) and INTACT experiments, SADL lowers the collapse rate over ten random seeds from 50% to 0%.
evidence.idea: We propose SADL (Supply And Demand Loss), which keeps the original training objective and constrains the encoder directly when needed.
bullets: In single-task and jointly trained four-task LeWorldModel (LeWM) and INTACT experiments, SADL lowers the collapse rate over ten random seeds from 50% to 0%.
On LeWM and INTACT, 1 epoch with SADL beats 10 epochs without it.
Beyond world models: in mainstream SSL with an aggressive recipe (lr ×4, no warmup), adding SADL alone lifts VICReg +8.4, BYOL +4.9, MoCo v3 +1.5, SimCLR +2.3 (ImageNet-100, ViT-S/16).
evidence.summary: We propose SADL (Supply And Demand Loss), which keeps the original training objective and constrains the encoder directly when needed.
evidence.practice_takeaway: Adding SADL sped up convergence and stabilized training.

lost_qualifier.why: The +8.4 VICReg gain holds only with an aggressive recipe (lr x4, no warmup), which the item drops.
